scope: P5.2 descriptive causal feature-family evidence only; no P5.3 state thresholds or production logic

canonical_price_data.daily_source: Binance spot klines using the existing P3.1 authority semantics
canonical_price_data.intraday_alignment: At a UTC 00:00 daily evaluation boundary, only 4h bars fully completed at or before that boundary may be used; the bar opening at the boundary is excluded.

features.formula: OLS slope of log BTC close on integer days over trailing 20 observations, multiplied by 365
OLS slope of log BTC close on integer days over trailing 40 observations, multiplied by 365
consecutive completed daily observations with BTC_close >= 95% of trailing_90d_max_close
Wilder RSI(14) on canonical daily BTC closes
Wilder RSI(28) on canonical daily BTC closes
Wilder RSI(14) on completed BTC 4h closes, sampled at the daily 00:00 UTC boundary
Wilder RSI(28) on completed BTC 4h closes, sampled at the daily 00:00 UTC boundary
percentile rank of current BTC close within trailing 20 closes minus percentile rank of current daily RSI14 within trailing 20 RSI14 values
fraction of trailing 14 daily RSI14 observations >=70
cross-sectional standard deviation of 20d log returns for BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB

pending.reason: No repository-validated historical BTC-dominance source is currently available without introducing a new external data authority.

features.formula: fraction of ETH/SOL/BNB whose 20d log return exceeds BTC 20d log return
fraction of ETH/SOL/BNB/XRP whose 20d log return exceeds BTC 20d log return; XRP remains feature-only
fraction of SOL and BNB whose 20d log return exceeds BTC 20d log return
trailing 10d max canonical5 breadth minus current canonical5 breadth

pending.reason: No frozen broader-market universe/data contract exists yet; the V1 canonical-five breadth is explicitly not claimed to be total-market breadth.
P5 requires a cross-event market-positioning source with 2021 and 2025 coverage; existing Hyperliquid funding authority begins too late for 2021 comparability.
No frozen reproducible historical OI source is currently in the repository.
No P5-specific fixed historical spot/perp basis panel has yet been frozen across all required events.
No validated continuous historical liquidation proxy is currently frozen.

event_summary_rule.buckets: Use exactly the P5.1 relative calendar buckets.
event_summary_rule.control_comparison: For each feature and bucket, pool HIGH_VOLATILITY_NON_TOP_CONTROL event-bucket daily observations; report control median and MAD plus signed robust-z of each event median versus controls when MAD>0.
event_summary_rule.selection_rule: P5.2 does not select a final feature set or state threshold. It reports coverage and descriptive separation evidence only.

coverage_rule.rule: An AVAILABLE_V1 feature below 95% nonmissing coverage across required evaluation rows is flagged COVERAGE_FAIL, not silently imputed. Warm-up rows before sufficient lookback are excluded only when they occur before the earliest required P5.1 evaluation bucket.

forbidden: move or relabel P5.1 event windows after feature results
choose RSI timeframe from visual intuition before common evaluation
invent a BTC-dominance or broad-market-breadth proxy and label it as the requested feature
use future data in a feature evaluated at date t
fit P5.3 state thresholds in the P5.2 evidence run
authorize production trading, leverage, withdrawals or external transfers

run_once.rule: After implementation/preflight CI is green, run the frozen feature-evidence suite once. Non-economic implementation defects may be corrected with an audited correction record; feature definitions/windows/metrics may not be retuned after evidence is observed.
